places.quote: We landed, and proceeded to Paris.
A few days before we left Paris on our way to Switzerland
places.note: Destination of the journey, not yet reached in this passage.

places.quote: He wished to obliterate the memory of the scenes that had taken place in Ireland
places.note: Scenes of Henry's murder; the country is named only in retrospect.

places.quote: since my journey to the sea of ice.
places.note: Descriptive name for the glacier; identification is inferred.

places.quote: I expect to see you looking even more ill than when you quitted Geneva.
